name: io.github.tonyyang0504/allegro-ecommerce-channels-mcp
description: Allegro (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders, mark_ship

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your app registered at apps.developer.allegro.pl; sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the token call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret of the same app.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code (or device-flow) consent of the seller account (valid 3 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new pair (access token 12 h + new refresh token) and the old refresh token stops working 60 seconds after its first use. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency of your offers' base marketplace, PLN for allegro.pl; used by update_listing for sellingMode.price {amount, currency}.
